children: BUUU Group said its board approved a 10-for-1 forward stock split, which will see the company's Class A and Class B ordinary shares be split into 10 shares each of the same class.
The company's Class A shares are expected to begin trading on a split-adjusted basis on the Nasdaq Capital Market on Oct. 26.
The split is intended to make shares more accessible to a broader base of investors, the company said.
The split follows the company's acquisition last month of 60% of Brightray Science and the decision to establish industrialized AI data center delivery as BUUU's core growth business.
BUUU Group shares closed the day's regular session at $41.31, falling just over 5%.
